scope: All 200 existing LinkedIn-origin leads in public.sales_leads.
methodology: First-party HTML, response headers/cookies, and bounded native endpoint probes. WooCommerce requires multiple active storefront signals or an active Store API plus a storefront signal; a WordPress/Woo asset alone is insufficient. Four fetch-blocked storefronts were verified through their rendered first-party assets.
platform_field_rule: Use the detected commerce platform when strong storefront evidence exists; otherwise record the underlying CMS/framework or Custom/Other. WordPress is explicitly labeled non-WooCommerce unless multiple active WooCommerce signals are present.
